proposed_single_job.registration: ROOT must register exact repair/diagnostic scope and scientific budgets before implementation/deployment
proposed_single_job.runner: One new task-specific runner; direct existing module calls. No new controller framework or per-operation billing.
proposed_single_job.inputs: Read existing absolute input paths, verify external artifact hashes once at job boundary; decode only registered TRAIN members.
proposed_single_job.execution: One native GPU child under existing supervise.py plus GNU timeout; no automatic restart; no other process manipulation.
proposed_single_job.logging: START.json contains config/source/input digests, device, seed and scope; metrics.jsonl or stdout once per coarse registered step block; at most one small rolling STATUS.json. No line-by-line audit stream.
proposed_single_job.checkpoint: If training is authorized, save one latest checkpoint at complete update boundary and final.pt; include intended trainable state, optimizer, completed step and RNG. Keep imported A/005 unchanged and reference their hashes. Do not save every forward.
proposed_single_job.terminal: RESULT.json or FAILED.json from runner; supervisor exit_receipt.json retains native code/signal. RESULT records executed counts at high level, decision and limitations, scientific_status=response_match_not_established unless registered acceptance passes.
proposed_single_job.receipt_collection: Collect small JSON/log/final checkpoint to E. Leave large private arrays on execution host. D backup unavailable at current free space.
proposed_single_job.startup_and_wakeup: Verify launch PID/cmd and first valid progress exactly once after start; schedule one future wakeup and end active turn. No continuous SSH polling.
